newerPrimaryResearch.title: Herschel impact basin probes the onset of a young ocean on mimas
newerPrimaryResearch.assessment: Abstract/introduction/methods read directly: iSALE-2D impacts can match Herschel in ocean-bearing or warm fully frozen shells near melting. Basin morphology alone does not uniquely require an ocean at formation. Simulated timing near onset of young ocean is an interpretation. Model assumes axisymmetric vertical impact, idealized target/ice and selected impactor velocities; chemistry, impact conditions and local terrain are not measured by these simulations.
